seoTitle: Njintieuh Sieni — Author of The Seven Kingdoms of K'Thari
seoDescription: Njintieuh Sieni is the Cameroonian-born, Florida-based author of The Seven Kingdoms of K'Thari, an African epic fantasy saga. Read his story, his influences, and what comes next in the K'Thari world.
name: Njintieuh Sieni
intro:
Njintieuh Sieni writes epic fantasy rooted in African cosmology and oral tradition. Born and raised in Cameroon and based in Florida, he grew up on stories told aloud — history, warning, and wonder passed down by voice. That tradition is the DNA of his work.

*The Seven Kingdoms of K'Thari: Blood of the Seven* is his debut, the first book in a planned twelve-volume saga: seven kingdoms, seven sacred animals, a dying crown, and a secret old enough to unmake them all.
quote: "I wrote the epic fantasy I never got to read growing up."
story:
A lifelong multi-hyphenate creative, Njintieuh came to novels the long way. He made music, then designed clothing, and now writes the stories he has been drafting and building for years — beginning with K'Thari. Storytelling is the thread through all of it. (Fair warning: he's a geek who hardly looks like one.)

He moved to the United States in 2010 and now writes from Florida, an ocean away from where these stories began — and that distance is part of why putting them on the page matters so much to him. K'Thari's magic, its kingdoms, and its idea that power is inherited and always answered for come from African cosmology and oral tradition rather than European myth.

He chose to publish independently so the story could reach readers everywhere without waiting for permission, building it out piece by piece — the manuscript, the maps, the art, the covers — while learning each part as he went. Book I is only the beginning: the saga widens from here, and his long-term ambition is to see K'Thari on the screen, a world built to be seen, not only read.
closingText: Start with Blood of the Seven, and follow Njintieuh for news of Book II.
